reason: Both use one Princeville base with no Na Pali boat tour and repeated long crossings. B adds more defining content (Kalalau Trail, Waimea Canyon Lookout, Poipu) but its Day 2 is impossible: it goes from Kalalau Lookout in Koke'e to the Hanakapi'ai trailhead in '20 min', starts a 4-hour strenuous hike at 14:00 with no Ha'ena reservation, and then makes a second 2h15 west-side round trip on Day 6. A is thinner (Kapaa Town, Koloa filler; its Day 2 return is also underestimated) but every day can be done.

A puts Feira da Ladra on a Friday (it runs Tuesdays and Saturdays) and has a 05:30 breakfast with São Jorge Castle at 06:15 on departure day, long before it opens. It also books two dinners on Day 1 (Ramiro, then A Severa). B has the castle at opening, Alfama, a fado evening and the flea market on the correct Saturday, though it labels Santa Luzia at 16:30 as 'sunset' (sunset is about 20:40). Neither plan includes Jerónimos or the Belém Tower.

A's Tenerife has one base (Puerto de la Cruz), mild March weather, free afternoons and easy family stops (botanical garden, Playa Jardín, Lago Martiánez, Roques de García). Its flaws: a night drive to Benijo on arrival, a late Teide stargazing night and some 3-hour driving days. B's Tongariro is anti-restful: a 05:30 start for the 7-hour Alpine Crossing followed by a further 3-hour hike on Day 6, a strenuous Ruapehu Crater Lake outing, a 4h20 driving day for a night walk, and 'stargazing' and 'glow-worm' slots at 18:00 in daylight. B's shortlist also offers Bali in its rainy season.

B skips Jökulsárlón and Diamond Beach entirely, which is a hard fail, and also misses Dettifoss and the East Fjords. It schedules Dyrhólaey on 21 June 'at sunset' at 16:30, when the real sunset is near midnight and the cliffs are within the nesting closure. A covers Reynisfjara, Jökulsárlón, Diamond Beach, Vestrahorn, Dettifoss and Akureyri, using the light evenings well. But it wastes Day 5 on a 4-hour out-and-back to Petra's Stone Collection, has Dyrhólaey on 15 June (inside the closure), and omits Skógafoss, Seljalandsfoss and the Golden Circle.

Both are rental-car, single-base plans with only short Kodo fragments and no inn-to-inn walking or luggage shuttle, and both present riverbed onsen digging. B edges ahead: it has a concrete onsen base (Kawayu), Oyunohara with Hongu on Day 2, Tsuboyu, and explicit one-way taxi and bus notes for its walks. Its Day 10 double-counts the Fushiogami-to-Hongu stretch. A's base 'Chikatsuyu/Hongu area' covers two villages about 30 km apart, its drive times are inconsistent, and it lacks Oyunohara.

Neither plan has a trek or a real yurt night. A's 'Song-Kol Lake shore' base is actually a Bishkek location: its Days 8–10 are Bishkek museums 6 km away by bus, it lists 'Song-Kol stargazing' at 18:00 in daylight, and travel is by bus and 'train' where no rail exists. A also starts at 05:30 for an animal market on the wrong day. B is equally wrong on transport (fictional trains to Ala Archa, Burana, Karakol and Jyrgalan) and omits Song-Kol, but it is geographically coherent (Bishkek, then Karakol) and puts an acclimatisation hike at Ala Archa early.

Both use a Corvara base and both skip Tre Cime. A leans on drives and strolls (Day 2 Dobbiaco and Cortina shopping, Day 4 a pass drive and a museum) and schedules Seceda at 06:30 on departure day, before the lifts run. B is far more hike-led: the Sorapis hike (Day 2), Cinque Torri, the Scotoni–Lagazuoi circuit, and Braies at 07:25, ahead of the 09:00–16:00 access restriction. Its weaknesses are a 05:30 start, a repeat visit to Lagazuoi with no via ferrata gear note, and an optional dawn trip to Santa Maddalena.

Both use one Lagos base with implausible 'train' legs and both admit the grandparents were not modelled. A breaks 'easy days' on Day 1 with arrival-night stargazing at Cabo de São Vicente from 22:30, getting back after 01:00. Its typical day has about 175 minutes of travel, and Day 5 includes the Rocha da Pena hike; its dolphin boat is its one plus. B has gentler beach-led days (Meia Praia, Dona Ana, Camilo, the Alvor boardwalk, Luz) with about 110 minutes of travel, but no boat or cave trip.

A spends 8 nights in Karatu with no Serengeti and no Tarangire, padding with village walks, a coffee tour and a Hadzabe visit, which fails the request outright. B has the correct northern circuit: Arusha, Tarangire (2 nights), the crater rim, a crater descent at first light, 3 Serengeti nights and a flight back. It does overclaim early-July Mara crossings as 'prime', show an absurd 527 km Maji Moto leg, list a rental car in bookings, and run Kogatende and Seronera from one unnamed base.

B is built around a rental car, the request's main red flag: it drives Tokyo, Hakone and Kyoto, including a 5.5-hour Hakone-to-Kyoto drive. It also has a geocoding error that places 'Kyoto Imperial Palace Park' in Tokyo on Day 1 and an impossible '374 km walk', and it visits Hakone twice. A honours rail with two sensible bases (Shinjuku 5 nights, Gion 4) and has early Fushimi Inari and Kiyomizu. Its Tokyo is thin (Day 2 is only Omoide Yokocho, and there is no Asakusa) and it overclaims blossom at Shinjuku Gyoen on 8 April.
